rawContent: Is there anything in the world quite as satisfying as Monica Lewinsky exacting second-act, post-#MeToo revenge through the medium of Twitter snark? Just perfect. https://t.co/w3fcFsHmS9

@Midj109 I don't carry a torch for Ken Starr, believe me. But the Clinton administration went into overdrive to baselessly portray her as an unhinged slut, and Hillary was fully complicit in that. The whole episode looks very different in a post-#MeToo light.
